reason: I put Khatabook on my phone once and stopped updating it in a week, so I don't believe another app will stick. Phone calls come while I'm weighing atta for someone, and I don't think it will catch those right.
objection: Will it really catch my phone-call orders correctly without me doing anything? If it gets one wrong and I miss a customer's udhaar, I'm back to my paper diary and have wasted my time.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it work on my own phone for a few days, with real calls and voice notes from my customers, and getting every order and udhaar entry right, with no extra work from me.
